name: Falldown 79: Bottle of Truth
source:
Find out the story of a simple guy who lives in Russia. Perhaps he would prefer to never leave his comfortable shelter and not see all the horrors of the street, but fate has prepared completely different plans for him and he has an exciting adventure ahead of him.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/907950/Falldown_79_Bottle_of_truth/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
了解一个生活在俄罗斯的普通男人的故事。也许他宁愿永远不离开舒适的避难所，不去看街上的一切恐怖景象，但命运为他准备了完全不同的计划，一场激动人心的冒险正在前方。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/907950/Falldown_79_Bottle_of_truth/]Steam[/url]]
